text:
maya: quick ask — can someone run a micro throughput sweep on the CB branch? suspect a regression when max_tokens=1024. need p50/p95 + throughput by EOD for the demo.

sam: on it, what's the exact loadgen command/config to use?

maya: use this (staging-3, seed=42, warmup 10s):

```
python tools/loadgen.py \
  --workload cb_sweep \
  --model redwood-mini-v1 \
  --max_tokens 1024 \
  --batch_window_ms 30 \
  --target_rps 200 \
  --duration 60 \
  --warmup 10 \
  --seed 42 \
  --enable-small-batch-fallback
```

linh: do we need KV-cache warmup for these runs? small-window runs have been flakey without it.

maya: yes include KV warmup. also enable the tiny-batch fallback flag. leave max_batch unset unless you hit queueing.

dev-bot: scheduled job created: sweep-3456709999 by maya — staging-3 queue.

ryan: I can run on staging-3 but heads-up: we've seen queueing cliffs on the smaller GPU workers; I'll cap max_batch_size to 8 for one variant.

sam: noted. I'll run two variants: max_batch=8 and max_batch=16, both with the command above. I'll post p50/p95 and throughput numbers.

linh: please also upload the perf profile and kernel traces to /perf/artifacts and tag me, I want to check kernel selection.

sam: posting results (batch=8 / batch=16):
- p50: 28ms / 31ms
- p95: 220ms / 320ms
- throughput: 180 tps / 240 tps

baseline (master) for same config was ~260 tps, so this branch looks regressed, especially p95 on larger batches.

maya: thanks — that matches my local repro. sounds like the new queue heuristic is causing delayed batch formation for long-token requests. can we get someone to open a quick revert/patch? @ryan?

ryan: I'll open a draft PR and link the run artifacts. assigning to @maya for review.

ops-bot: alert — CI flake detected: cb-sweep-smoke on staging-3. rerun scheduled automatically.

maya: follow-ups: run the same sweep with --max_tokens=512 and with the quantized kernel flag to check token-length sensitivity.

sam: queued the 512 run, plus one with --use-quant-kernel. will post results in this thread.

linh: if token-length sensitivity shows up, we should add a smokecheck gated on max_tokens=1024 for the canary rollout.

sam: results for 512: throughput 230 tps, p95 210ms. quantized kernel: throughput 225 tps, p95 205ms. looks like the regression is worse at 1024.

maya: summary: regression introduced by the queue heuristic change, disproportionately affects long max_tokens. plan: revert the heuristic for now, add a canary smokecheck for max_tokens=1024, and follow up with a more conservative heuristic that respects inflight KV warmup. PR in progress. Thanks everyone :rocket:

ryan: PR opened: github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4321 (draft). linked perf artifacts and runs.

sam: copied artifacts to thread: /perf/artifacts/sweep-3456709999.tar.gz and included raw loadgen logs.

linh: added cb-smoke gate proposal to the rollout job. will send the short RFC after lunch.

maya: perfect. if no objections I'll merge the revert after the canary completes. appreciate the quick turnaround folks. :thumbsup:
